Name: Pridematic Shards
Author: Symtrkl
Description:
[b]What does Pridematic Shards do?
[/b]It makes the world of Stardew Valley just a little more gay, with pride flag themed Prismatic Shards. And also a colorless option if you want your Prismatic Shards to be Monochromatic Shards. I'm not gonna judge.

[b]Okay but how?
[/b]Pridematic Shards is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], just select your pride flag, and whether you want to use the pun names for them if you're as silly as I am.

[b]What if I like being a nerd?
[/b]Same. Just edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] in the mod's folder, the options are self explanatory. Change "Rename Shard" to true or false as desired, and "Pride Flag" to one of these options:
[list]
[*]Rainbow
[*]Monochromatic
[*]Agender
[*]Ambiamorous
[*]Aromantic
[*]AroAce
[*]Asexual
[*]Bisexual
[*]Demiboy
[*]Demigender
[*]Demigirl
[*]Demiromantic
[*]Demisexual
[*]Enbian
[*]Genderfluid
[*]Genderqueer
[*]Intersex
[*]Lesbian
[*]Nonbinary
[*]Pansexual
[*]Polyamorous
[*]Polysexual
[*]Sapphic
[*]Transgender
[*]Trixic
[*]Vincian
[/list]
[b]No, I really like being a nerd. I want to customize the names. Your puns are lame.[/b]
Wow, rude.

Open up [font=Courier New]content.json[/font] and scroll down to the pride flag you want to change. You're looking for a field called "DisplayName." It's just that easy.

[b]What if I want the ROYGBIV or monochromatic shards without all these woke pronouns?[/b]
Then you'll die disappointed. <3
